# nd_inventory_switch (Data Source)

Reads switches from a fabric inventory, optionally selecting one by serial number.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nd_inventory_switch" "test_datasource_inventory_switch_1" {
  fabric_name = "my_fabric"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_name` (String) Name of the fabric containing the switch.

### Optional

- `serial_number` (String) Optional switch serial number. When specified, only the matching switch is returned.

### Read-Only

- `switches` (Attributes List) Switches currently present in the fabric inventory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--switches))
